author: dahbeast999
body:
When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network please include the following: 
  • Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed)
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.
dahbeast999

I was temp-banned for three days because of team griefing for blowing under the spawn with tnt.

I think I should be unbanned because I have learned my lesson and I really care about this server.  Not to say just that I care justifies my infraction.  But that I have learned my lesson and won't do it again.
